subject: App posting 'Page not found' and/or 'Unable to access the network' errors

messages.author: f7f0d794e35757b6
messages.subject: App posting 'Page not found' and/or 'Unable to access the network' errors
parts:
Hi,

   I am sort of new to shiny app development.  I have been working for a little while on an app to visualize data and everything works fine locally.  No problems when running deployApp().  However, linking to the URL provided by shinyapps.io results in a 'Page not found' or a "Unable to access the network' error (I seem to get one or the other whenever I link to it or try to refresh the page).

   Any ideas?  This is for a collaborative project so it's pretty important to me that I get this figured out.

   Thanks.

Best Regards,

Kellen Gracey

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: App posting 'Page not found' and/or 'Unable to access the network' errors
parts:
Hi Kellen,
I found the problem. You have your server.R and ui.R files in a sub-directory (my_app).

If you goto https://kgracey.shinyapps.io/fsoltShinyProject/my_app/, then it works ok.

Make sure in the future that the server.R and ui.R files are in the root directory of the project. thanks.
